answer: Identities post a refundable bond to earn, and collusion caught by auditors forfeits it entirely. The reward nectar draws attackers, but every fake wallet on the ridge of a sybil cluster now risks losing its stake when cross-grading rings are detected. Honesty keeps the bond hard and clear as quartz; coordinated fakery melts it. Mass identities stop being free options and become a pile of stakes waiting to be slashed.
